15201.name: The Gate Of Fameland

north.description: To the north lies The Path of Heroes.

east.description: To the east lies The Temple Library.

west.description: To the west lies In The Halls Of Fameland.

15201.description:
Tall pillars of white marble flank the gate of Fameland, their capitals
wreathed in carved laurel and gilded at the edges. A pair of bronze
doors, green with age and sealed by a heavy bar, stand shut on the
north, and beyond them lies a path no living foot has trodden in years.
East, a door leads back to the Temple Library, while the hall continues
west beneath a vaulted ceiling. Braziers of white fire burn in niches on
either side.

15202.name: In The Halls Of Fameland

east.description: To the east lies The Gate Of Fameland.

west.description: To the west lies Intersection To Adventure.

15202.description:
A long gallery of polished marble stretches ahead, its floor so smooth
that the flames of the wall braziers shine twice over. Alcoves in the
walls hold statues of armoured figures, each plinth bearing a name in
gold leaf. The air is cool and still and tastes faintly of incense. The
gate lies east, and the gallery runs on west.

15203.name: Intersection To Adventure

north.description: To the north lies The Halls Of Victory.

east.description: To the east lies In The Halls Of Fameland.

south.description: To the south lies The Room Of Mercy.

15203.description:
Three halls meet here on a floor inlaid with a great golden compass rose
set in black and white stone. A tall statue of a hero with a raised
sword stands at the centre, his shadow thrown long by the surrounding
braziers. Pale banners hang from the vault, their embroidered devices
faded past reading. The gallery leads east back toward the gate, one
hall runs north into splendour, and another south toward quieter
chambers.

15204.name: The Halls Of Victory

north.description: To the north lies The Halls Of Victory.

south.description: To the south lies Intersection To Adventure.

15204.description:
The Halls of Victory begin with a broad avenue of red-veined marble,
lined by pairs of bronze pillars crowned with laurel. Captured standards
hang from the walls in long, stiff folds, their poles crossed over
painted shields. A drum the height of a man rests on a stone plinth
bearing the date of some forgotten triumph. The hall runs on north, and
back south it meets the great crossing.

15205.name: The Halls Of Victory

south.description: To the south lies The Halls Of Victory.

west.description: To the west lies The Halls Of Victory.

15205.description:
Here the hall turns, and a magnificent trophy wall rises to the roof,
hung with broken spears, dented helms and the blades of defeated
enemies. Beneath each trophy a small marble plaque records the battle
where it was won. Torches in golden sconces burn with a steady flame
that gives no smoke. The hall leads south toward the crossing and bends
west.

15206.name: The Halls Of Victory

east.description: To the east lies The Halls Of Victory.

west.description: To the west lies The Halls Of Victory.

15206.description:
A long corridor stands lined on both sides with carved panels depicting
charge, siege and rout in fine marble relief. Wreaths of bronze laurel
have been fixed above every door frame, gone black with age. The faint
smell of old oil and polished stone lingers, and somewhere a sound like
distant trumpets seems to fade as you listen. The hall continues east
and west.

15207.name: The Halls Of Victory

east.description: To the east lies The Halls Of Victory.

south.description: To the south lies Chamber Of The Fallen Ones.

15207.description:
The victory halls end in a chamber with a vaulted ceiling painted with a
golden sunrise over a field of banners. Beneath it a marble plinth holds
a laurel crown cast in bronze, set before a carved roll listing the
victors by rank. The air is cold enough to raise a shiver. The hall runs
back east, and a dark archway leads south into the Chamber of the Fallen
Ones.

15209.name: Chamber Of The Fallen Ones

west.description: To the west lies Chamber Of The Fallen Ones.

15209.description:
A small stone alcove, its walls hung with torn pennants of regiments
long disbanded. A bench of cold marble faces a carved roll where each
name has a single date beside it. A bowl of white sand holds a few
burnt-down incense sticks left by earlier visitors. The only way out is
the archway west into the chamber.

15210.name: Chamber Of The Fallen Ones

north.description: To the north lies The Halls Of Victory.

east.description: To the east lies Chamber Of The Fallen Ones.

south.description: To the south lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

west.description: To the west lies Chamber Of The Fallen Ones.

15210.description:
A round chamber of grey stone, hushed and solemn, with a cenotaph of
black marble at its heart. Names of the fallen are carved up the walls
in tight rows, some freshly cut and some worn almost smooth. Candles in
iron holders gutter though no draught stirs. Archways open east and west
into smaller niches, the way north returns to the victory halls, and a
passage runs south into the Chambers of Sorrow.

15211.name: Chamber Of The Fallen Ones

east.description: To the east lies Chamber Of The Fallen Ones.

15211.description:
A narrow alcove, tucked away from the grand chamber, where a single
stone sarcophagus has been set into the wall. The inscription on its
face is half rubbed away, as if many hands had touched it. A small lamp
with a flame the colour of pearl burns on a ledge. The only way out is
east, back into the Chamber of the Fallen Ones.

15212.name: The Chambers Of Sorrow

north.description: To the north lies Chamber Of The Fallen Ones.

south.description: To the south lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

west.description: To the west lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

15212.description:
Soft grey light seeps from lamps behind frosted glass, falling on walls
inscribed with laments in flowing letters. Marble weeping figures kneel
in niches, their faces veiled in carved cloth. The chamber is cold and
its echo is strange, as if it answered a few moments late. The Chamber
of the Fallen Ones lies north, the passage runs south, and an arch opens
west.

15213.name: The Chambers Of Sorrow

north.description: To the north lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

south.description: To the south lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

15213.description:
A narrow passage of dark stone, its floor worn into two shallow channels
by the passage of mourners. Black ribbons hang from iron hooks along the
walls, brittle with age and rustling faintly. Each hook has a name
stamped on a tiny brass tag, though many have gone green and are
unreadable. The passage runs north and south.

15214.name: The Chambers Of Sorrow

north.description: To the north lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

west.description: To the west lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

15214.description:
A slow bend in the passage, with a low alcove cut into the wall where a
lamp burns before a stone urn. Dry petals lie scattered around its base,
still faintly fragrant after years. The walls are lined with rows of
little tablets, each carved with a single word of farewell. The passage
goes back north and turns west.

15215.name: The Chambers Of Sorrow

north.description: To the north lies A Small Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

south.description: To the south lies The Corridors Of Remembrance.

west.description: To the west lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15215.description:
Four passages meet here beneath a low dome whose underside is painted
with a night sky of silver stars. A fountain with no water in it stands
in the middle, its basin filled with white pebbles left by mourners.
Faint singing from nowhere seems to drift through the stone. Ways lead
north to a small chamber, east into the Chambers of Sorrow, south toward
the corridors, and west into the Halls of Eternity.

15216.name: A Small Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

south.description: To the south lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

15216.description:
A small, bare chamber with a single stone bench and a candle in a niche,
kept for those who wish to grieve alone. The walls are plain except for
a narrow band of carved lilies running around at shoulder height. The
silence is deep enough to hear your own breath. The doorways lead north
and south.

15217.name: The Chambers Of Sorrow

east.description: To the east lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15217.description:
The passage widens into a hall of tall pillars, each carved with the
figure of a mourning woman holding a lamp. A lintel above the arch is
inscribed with the words of a lament that fade into the stone as you
read. Cold air breathes in from the way west, and the dust on the floor
lies undisturbed. A door leads east, an archway leads south into a
little chamber, and the hall opens west into the Halls of Eternity.

15218.name: The Corridors Of Remembrance

north.description: To the north lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

south.description: To the south lies The Corridors Of Remembrance.

15218.description:
A plain corridor with a low ceiling, kept dim so that the letters on the
walls gleam in the little light there is. Rows of oblong plaques
commemorate the dead of some old war, and their names are arranged by
company. A bench is set into the wall for those who wish to read slowly.
The corridor leads north to the Chambers of Sorrow and south to a
junction.

15219.name: The Corridors Of Remembrance

north.description: To the north lies The Corridors Of Remembrance.

east.description: To the east lies Chambers Of Heroes.

west.description: To the west lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15219.description:
A narrow corridor of grey stone runs along a wall of memorial tablets,
each carved with a name and a line of remembrance. Small lamps burn
beneath them, and many have been replenished with fresh oil. The passage
forks here, one way leading north, another west to the Halls of
Eternity, and a broad arch opening east into the Chambers of Heroes.

15220.name: Chambers Of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies Chambers Of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies Chambers Of Heroes.

west.description: To the west lies The Corridors Of Remembrance.

15220.description:
Here the chambers of the heroes begin, a great high-roofed hall lined
with life-sized bronze statues on stone pedestals. Each hero is shown in
the pose of a famous moment, sword drawn or banner raised or hand
reaching out to a fallen friend. A banner of yellow silk hangs above the
doorway, bordered with gold fringes. The hall runs north and south, and
an arch leads west to the corridors.

15221.name: Chambers Of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies Chambers Of Heroes.

east.description: To the east lies The Way Of Heroes.

15221.description:
The corner of the Chambers of Heroes is dominated by a colossal statue
of a woman in plate, her visor raised and her sword planted before her
like a cross. Fresh lamps burn at her feet in a ring, and the floor
around her is polished by kneeling. Her carved eyes seem to follow
whoever approaches. A passage runs north, and the way east leads to the
Way of Heroes.

15222.name: The Way Of Heroes

east.description: To the east lies Chambers Of Heroes.

west.description: To the west lies Chambers Of Heroes.

15222.description:
This is the Way of Heroes itself, a broad processional road of white
stone between rows of pillars, each pillar topped by a statue facing the
way. Gold leaf runs in the grooves of the paving, worn thin by centuries
of walking. A deep, ceremonial hush lies over everything. The way leads
east into a chamber and west into another.

15223.name: Chambers Of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies The Room Of Mercy.

west.description: To the west lies The Way Of Heroes.

15223.description:
The hall opens into a splendid chamber whose floor is inlaid with an
immense laurel wreath in gold. Statues in the niches around it hold
lamps aloft, giving a warm, steady light. A plaque at the entrance names
the fallen who held this very spot. A doorway north leads to the Room of
Mercy, and the way continues west toward a famous road.

15224.name: The Room Of Mercy

north.description: To the north lies Chambers Of Heroes.

east.description: To the east lies The Room Of Mercy.

south.description: To the south lies Chambers Of Heroes.

15224.description:
The Room of Mercy is round and white-walled, lit by a high oculus that
casts a pillar of cold light on a stone altar. Offerings of ribbons,
coins and small carved charms lie on its surface. A bronze bowl for
tears stands beside it, polished by many hands. Doorways lead north,
east and south.

15225.name: Chambers Of Heroes

south.description: To the south lies The Room Of Mercy.

west.description: To the west lies Chambers Of Heroes.

15225.description:
The statues give way to a wall of hanging shields, hundreds of them,
each painted with the device of a family or order. Some are cracked,
some gilded, and some covered with a black cloth where the house has
died out. A low rail in front keeps the curious from touching. The
chamber turns here, with a doorway south into the Room of Mercy and the
hall going west.

15226.name: Chambers Of Heroes

east.description: To the east lies Chambers Of Heroes.

west.description: To the west lies Chambers Of Heroes.

15226.description:
A wide avenue of statues stretches through the chamber, set in pairs
facing each other across the polished floor. Each pair is a champion and
the foe who nearly bested them, carved with equal respect. A wall of
honour plaques runs behind them, spaced with painted heraldry. The hall
runs east and west.

15227.name: Chambers Of Heroes

east.description: To the east lies Chambers Of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies Chambers Of Heroes.

15227.description:
Marble statues of four heroes stand shoulder to shoulder in this corner
of the hall, their cloaks carved so fine they seem to ripple. At their
feet lies a stone shield, scored by the blows of a real fight, set into
the floor as a memorial. The braziers at either end give a light like
melted amber. The hall turns here, running east and back south.

15228.name: The Room Of Mercy

north.description: To the north lies The Room Of Mercy.

west.description: To the west lies The Room Of Mercy.

15228.description:
A small, serene chamber where the walls are covered in soft grey drapery
and the floor is strewn with rushes. A carved bench runs round three
sides beneath a frieze of open hands. The flames in the brazier are low
and bluish, giving a hush to the room. The room opens north and west.

15229.name: The Room Of Mercy

north.description: To the north lies Through The Halls Of Mercy.

east.description: To the east lies The Honor Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Room Of Mercy.

15229.description:
Pale marble in the shape of a kneeling figure fills an alcove in this
room, one hand outstretched in forgiveness. Candle stubs gather in a
heap around its base, melted into fantastic shapes. A heavy oak door
east is bound with brass and marked with a wreath. The passage runs
north and back south.

15230.name: Through The Halls Of Mercy

north.description: To the north lies Through The Halls Of Mercy.

east.description: To the east lies The Honor Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Room Of Mercy.

west.description: To the west lies The Honor Room.

15230.description:
Doors in three directions open from this crossing of the Halls of Mercy,
each framed by an arch of pale stone and a polished brass plate. The
floor is laid with a mosaic of a dove carrying an olive branch, its
colours kept fresh by regular scrubbing. A faint draught flutters the
candle flames. Ways lead north and south, and doors lead east and west
into honour rooms.

15231.name: Through The Halls Of Mercy

east.description: To the east lies The Honor Room.

south.description: To the south lies Through The Halls Of Mercy.

west.description: To the west lies The Room Of Mercy.

15231.description:
The passage ends in a dead-end hall with a high ceiling hung with paper
lanterns, each inscribed with a wish for the departed. They sway
slightly, though nothing moves the air. A heavy wooden door to the east
is carved with a laurel wreath. The hall leads back south, and an
archway opens west into the Room of Mercy.

15232.name: The Room Of Mercy

north.description: To the north lies Intersection To Adventure.

east.description: To the east lies Through The Halls Of Mercy.

15232.description:
A quiet, shadowed hall of tall narrow windows set with milky glass,
through which comes a soft diffused light. A long rug of faded rose
leads between two rows of benches, towards a lectern. The walls are bare
except for a single plaque reading a verse on kindness. The hall runs
north to the crossing and east toward the Halls of Mercy.

15233.name: The Halls Of Eternity

east.description: To the east lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

south.description: To the south lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15233.description:
The Halls of Eternity begin in a long hall of dark green marble,
polished until it mirrors the braziers that never go out. Rows of
statues stand along the walls, each with a plaque naming its deeds in
letters of gold. The air hums faintly, like a held note. The hall opens
east into the Chambers of Sorrow and turns south.

15234.name: The Halls Of Eternity

north.description: To the north lies The Halls Of Eternity.

south.description: To the south lies The Halls Of Eternity.

west.description: To the west lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15234.description:
Three wide ways meet in a small court of pale stone, where a single
flame burns in a bronze bowl on a pedestal. Its light throws the shadows
of the surrounding statues long across the floor, so that they appear to
lean toward you. A scroll of beaten gold hangs on the wall, listing
those who kept faith. The halls lead north, south and west.

15235.name: The Halls Of Eternity

north.description: To the north lies The Halls Of Eternity.

east.description: To the east lies The Chambers Of Sorrow.

15235.description:
A short hall of white marble ends at a wall where a vast mosaic shows a
procession of heroes climbing toward a golden door. The tiles glitter in
the light of two tall braziers that have burned since before anyone's
grandfather. A bench of polished stone invites you to rest, though the
stone is cold as a river. The hall runs north, and an archway leads east
into the Chambers of Sorrow.

15236.name: The Halls Of Eternity

east.description: To the east lies The Halls Of Eternity.

south.description: To the south lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15236.description:
The hall turns a corner here between two great pillars wrapped in carved
ivy and bearing the names of heroes at their feet. A banner of deep blue
silk, embroidered with a silver star, hangs from an iron pole and stirs
though the air is still. The flagstones are worn pale along the centre
by pilgrims' feet. The hall leads east toward the court and south along
a gallery.

15237.name: The Halls Of Eternity

north.description: To the north lies The Halls Of Eternity.

south.description: To the south lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15237.description:
A straight gallery of dark stone, with statues standing on either side
like soldiers on parade. Each wears a different harness and holds a
different weapon, but all have the same calm, unseeing eyes. Their
plaques bear dates in ancient numerals, and a thin layer of dust lies
over everything but the floor. The gallery runs north and south.

15238.name: The Halls Of Eternity

north.description: To the north lies The Halls Of Eternity.

south.description: To the south lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15238.description:
Gilded honour rolls fill the walls of this stretch of the hall, line
upon line of names with the title and deed set beside each. A brazier on
a tripod burns at either end, the flames white and steady, unflickering
in any breath. The cold seems to gather around the lowest panels, where
the newest names have been cut. The gallery goes north and south.

15239.name: The Halls Of Eternity

north.description: To the north lies The Halls Of Eternity.

east.description: To the east lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15239.description:
The gallery bends beside a tall window of coloured glass, which throws
crimson and gold across the marble. Beneath it a stone trough holds a
heap of withered garlands laid by mourners long gone. A line of small
bronze lamps burns along the sill, each marked with a name. The hall
leads back north and goes on east.

15240.name: The Halls Of Eternity

east.description: To the east lies The Halls Of Eternity.

west.description: To the west lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15240.description:
A broad vaulted passage, its ceiling painted midnight blue and spangled
with golden stars. Trophies of old campaigns fill the wall niches: a
cracked drum, a bent trumpet, a captain's helm with its plume rotted
away. The floor is inlaid with a long strip of laurel leaves in green
stone. The passage runs east and west.

15241.name: The Halls Of Eternity

east.description: To the east lies The Corridors Of Remembrance.

west.description: To the west lies The Halls Of Eternity.

15241.description:
The hall ends in a pair of high pillars crowned with winged victories of
bronze, their wings dark with age. Between them a floor of black and
white squares leads on like a great game board. A faint scent of lilies
hangs in the air, though no flower grows in this place. The way leads
west back along the hall, and east into the corridors.

15242.name: The Honor Room

east.description: To the east lies Through The Halls Of Mercy.

15242.description:
Banners of a vanished kingdom hang here in fading ranks, their crowns
and lions barely visible. A marble table holds a book of names bound in
black leather, chained to its stand and open to a page with a ribbon.
The room is bitterly cold, as if winter had settled in the corners. The
only door leads east.

15243.name: The Honor Room

west.description: To the west lies Through The Halls Of Mercy.

15243.description:
A small private shrine for a single hero, its walls hung with a tapestry
of a battlefield at dawn. A stone sarcophagus stands in the centre, the
lid carved with a recumbent figure with hands crossed on a sword.
Eternal candles burn in four brass stands around it. The only way out is
the door west.

15244.name: The Honor Room

west.description: To the west lies Through The Halls Of Mercy.

15244.description:
This honour room is a low vault, its walls lined with niches that each
hold a small bronze urn and a palm leaf of carved stone. A single lamp
burns in the middle of the floor, on a pedestal wrapped in brass vines.
The names on the urns are in an old tongue, and the air smells of cedar.
The door west leads back to the Halls of Mercy.

15245.name: The Honor Room

west.description: To the west lies The Room Of Mercy.

15245.description:
A grander honour room, its walls panelled in dark wood and hung with
portraits of heroes in oils, their eyes dark and attentive. Crossed
swords are mounted over a stone fireplace in which no fire has been laid
for generations. Velvet chairs stand around a table set with a goblet of
dry dust. The heavy door leads west.
